title: sdfcube DMSO-water (distinct), nsumt = 5 without a cube file
purpose: Exercises `sdfcube` [@epsrmanual] for two different molecule types (spatial density of water around DMSO) and the start of an accumulation when no previous cube file exists.
system: The EPSR-test configuration `200DMSO400Water.ato`: 200 DMSO (atoms S, C, C, O, 6 H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1, H1; SPC/E parameters [@berendsen1987]), 3200 atoms at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å, a model of the DMSO-water mixtures of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. `sdfcube` histograms the centres of the second molecules, rotated into the frame of each central molecule (Euler angles from the axis definitions), on a cubic grid and writes the spatial density function as a Gaussian `.cube` file together with the averaged molecules (`-first.xyz`, `-second.xyz`). Here water centres (O1) around DMSO (centre = mass centre of S, O and C; z axis towards O, x axis towards the C-C midpoint) on a 21×21×21 grid (`mpixel 10`, `rmax 8`), with the "molecule 1 at origin" pass of distinct types.
inputs: Input files written by hand from the keyword tables (`setup_symbols_*`), one `keyword value` per line, ended by `q`; `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied from EPSR-test. `dmsowat.SDFCUBE.dat` with `nsumt 5` and `averagemol n`; compared with ex75 it adds distinct molecule types and a three-type central group.
verification: One pass. With `nsumt 5` but no cube file, `initcube` resets `nsumt` to 0, so the cube is a fresh accumulation and the saved input file has `nsumt 1` (reference `dmsowat.SDFCUBE.dat`). Compared: `dmsowat.SDFCUBE.cube`, `-first.xyz`, `-second.xyz` and the updated input file.
